layout.window_enlargement_acceptance: same actual targets, trajectories, illuminated atom sets and timing with enlarged padding; empty coverage rectangles may differ

production_measurement.startup: from unprepared world to first accepted, canonical, deliverable state
production_measurement.steady_state: accepted deliverable output count / measured interval after warmup
production_measurement.retry_cost: include all raw and final rejections, cleanup, resets and waiting
production_measurement.output_sink: explicit handoff/release required before carrier reuse
production_measurement.acceptance_model: must be named and versioned by the logical runner; no implicit acceptance=1
production_measurement.ec_policy: must record raw extra rounds, inter-operation and waiting maintenance policy
production_measurement.output_error: null unless supported by an independently checked model

run_limits.on_limit: record censored/unsupported cell; do not report it as a completed result
run_limits.extension: next odd distance and doubled N only after supported prior cells pass

level2_design_inputs: level1 accepted output arrival traces by seed and pipeline
output carrier coordinates, occupancy and logical state convention
output quality evidence and unsupported fields
component durations/exposure at actual source and target locations
shared AOD/readout admission constraints and retained resource claims
level2_candidate_layouts: central second-level factory with adjacent first-level buffers
first-level factories surrounding the second-level factory

level2_comparison.matched_output_error_target: only when both candidates have supported quality estimates
